limits: AMD 17h/19h/1Ah P-state definitions are read-only and capability-gated. Configured MHz is not a live measurement; uncertain DFS codes have no numeric frequency.
EL7 target is Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64; other RHEL/CentOS 7 configurations have not been certified.
Legacy VID is a low-byte fragment with raw bit 32 preserved separately. P-state writes, model-specific physical voltage/current conversions and physical hardware acceptance remain incomplete.
Windows/macOS test the portable core, not a complete hardware backend.
ICCmax/VR, Vmax/extended TVB, remaining AMD and motherboard controls, and Secure Boot acceptance remain incomplete.

original_instruction_replay.scope: Only the original legacy-frequency arithmetic branch; synthetic extraction of bits 13:8. No full original function/GUI/MSR execution.
observations: The original branch accepts DFS 08h..1Ah and even 1Ch..2Ch, and returns zero for the other codes.
DFS 09h divides by 1.25 in the original instructions, whereas AMD OSRR specifies 1.125.
Other accepted codes use FID * 25 / (DFS / 8); the original truncates the result to integer MHz.
FID below 10h is not rejected by this arithmetic branch. The new decoder checks the reserved FID range.

local_user_port_tests.context: Windows lacks native Linux/C++ tooling; corresponding cloud checks execute without these skips. Existing user extensions retained.
